title: Rabbi Avtolos, an Amora
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Menachot 53a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.53a.13): Rabbi Ezra, grandson of Rabbi Avtolos, was tenth in descent from Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah, who was tenth in descent from Ezra.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage names Rabbi Ezra as Rabbi Avtolos’s grandson. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Menachot.53a.13.1) explains that Rabbi Elazar ben Azaryah was ten generations removed from Ezra the Scribe.

The first tenth-generation clause can be read as referring to Ezra or to Avtolos. Hyman’s wording is rendered here as referring to Ezra. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=131&lang=en) separately records son and grandson as alternatives.
